newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME UP.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME UP.

text.p: Stock turnover and traded volume rose at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover grew to 1.215 million denars from 402,408 denars at the previous session on Tuesday as 456 shares traded, up from 216.
Gradinar-Loza AD shares made a debut on the third floor, selling 456 stocks at 2,665 denars, above par of 2,662 denars.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=40.74 denars; 1DEM=26.62 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
